captures.description: 'The Journal of Compression Studies is an online, distributed academic journal that acts as the foundational text for the emerging discipline of Compression Studies. It explores the nature of semantic compression, what survives when knowledge is reduced to portable formats, and how meaning is preserved in the digital age' (cites SciLynk +4). Expanded: 'The journal was established by scholar Lee Sharks in April 2026, launching with its inaugural issue on the Zenodo Open Access Platform. It is distributed primarily across open-access repositories and digital archives, focusing on the future of information indexing and semantic economies.'
